item.tib: bder gshegs rig 'dzin dgongs pa kun 'dus 'chi med gsang ba sum dril rgyud las sbyin bsreg me dpung dgu dril
item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan gar dbang rad+na gling pa'am/ 'chi med 'jam dpal rol pa'i rdo rje rtsal lam/ grub rigs spa yi rgyud las dal rten brnyed pa spral pa'i ye shes g.yung drung bstan pa'i nyi ma rang nyid bgrang bya nyer gnyis pa chu pho sprel lo'i cho 'phrul zla ba'i dkar phyogs sangs rgyas gshen rab mi bo sku 'khrungs pa'i dus chen skabs dbal bon ru lag shel ri phyug mo'i ngo mtshar zla gam phug gi chu srin gre ba nas spyan drangs te/ slar grub gnyis 'dzin pa g.yung drung bstan pa'i 'brug grags bsod nams dpal bzang po dang spa ston tshul khrims dbang rgyal gtsos las ldan bla grwa du ma nas rten 'brel lha gos dang maN Dal gyis mtshams sbyar nas bskul ba dang / nye bar rgyal sras pad+ma 'phrin las sras yum lhan rgyas nas rab dkar lha reg dang bcas bskul bzhin chu bya sa ga zla ba'i tshes bzang por shog ser bod yig tu bsgar te drung yig pa ni tshul khrims blo ldan dang yi ge dang po'i byed po 'gru rigs bon po drung mu nas bris pas gsang chen sngags kyi bstan pa me ltar 'bar ba'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
